title: console: on an object's default record page, a call or meeting the user logs never appears: the synthesized feed hides every completed sys_activity row, so Log a Call writes a row no page shows
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with reach measured (class a). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` execution seat (seat post objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1353, `session_01WnMDsLSaUQUD41WaWnADcF`) from the dev report on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2071 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2079). ⛔ Not graded here: objectui triage grades and routes. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

Measured by the dev on `objectstack dev` with `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 (the console it bundles), HotCRM's `crm_contact`. The object has no authored record page, so it renders the platform's default page, whose header offers Log a Call / Log a Meeting.
- `POST /api/v1/actions/crm_contact/log_call` → 200. `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` shows one row of type `completed` for the contact.
- The contact page's Discussion feed has 0 matches for the call's subject, before and after the app change below.
- The same filter hides `send_email`'s `completed` row on contacts (the note on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2061).

## Why

- The default record page synthesizer emits `record:discussion` / `record:activity` with no props.
- `RecordActivityProps.showCompleted` defaults to `false` (`@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, `src/ui/component.zod.ts` ~1752).
- The feed filter drops kind `task` unless `showCompleted === true`, and the type map sends `completed` to `task`.

So a logged interaction, which is `completed` by construction, is filtered out as if it were a finished to-do. An app cannot change this on an object it does not author a page for, short of authoring a whole record page to set one prop.

The same app fixed its authored pages by setting `showCompleted: true` (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2079: the case and opportunity `record:activity` blocks, and the account's `record:chatter` `feed`). That is one prop per page, repeated on every authored page that offers Log a Call. The platform default is where it belongs (HotCRM's rule: "a bad platform default is fixed at the default").

## Expected

On the default record page, a call or meeting logged on the record appears in its feed. Whether that is done by the synthesizer setting `showCompleted`, or by the filter not treating logged interactions (or any non-task `completed` row) as finished tasks, is for triage. The second also covers authored pages.

## Related

- #12106 (closed): the same filter hid an object's `activityMilestones` rows ("Case resolved"). That fix is for milestones only; logged calls and meetings still match the filter.
- #8934 (closed): `feed` filter members on `record:chatter` / `record:discussion`.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` (semantic, objectstack-ai/objectui, all states), two queries:
- "default record page synthesized discussion activity feed hides completed activities showCompleted logged call not shown" → 4 hits;
- "record:discussion record:activity default props completed sys_activity rows hidden log call" → 0 hits.

None on point. The nearest are #12106 and #8934 above.

Seam: spec:`RecordActivityProps.showCompleted` (default false) → renderer: default record page synthesizer (`record:discussion`, no feed) + the activity feed's `task`-kind filter
